source.title: ONE PIECE: Grand Gourmet
source.evidenceText: Slide 1 of 7Alcohol Reference, Mild Fantasy ViolenceGamesONE PIECE: Grand GourmetVersionNintendo Switch 2EditionDigitalAlcohol Reference, Mild Fantasy ViolenceLoadingSeason the SeasONE PIECE comes to life as a restaurant management sim game!As a new staff member, work alongside the Straw Hat Crew to turn the second location of the renowned Baratie floating restaurant into the greatest restaurant of the seas!Dish Out a Signature MenuGet inspired by characters' ideas, choose your ingredients, and work with Sanji to cook delicious dishes. Arrange them into unique meal sets by adding different flourishes, then adventure to find even more recipes! From iconic series favorites like Water-Water Meat BBQ and Sea King Penne Gorgonzola to special creations that harness the powers of Devil Fruits, a treasure trove of dishes awaits.Design A Tasteful InteriorChoose from over 200 furniture, building, and decorative items to make your restaurant uniquely yours! From dessert-themed Whole Cake Island pieces to futuristic Egghead items, the customization options are as vast as the sea. If a character likes your design, they may even become a regular!Table for 400From the Straw Hat Crew and beyond, over 400 ONE PIECE characters appear as staff and customers in a spritely pixel style for the first time in a game! With so many characters, you'll experience character events and special character interactions that can’t be found anywhere else.Software description provided by the publisher.Explore this game's official websiteAbout this itemGame file size (estimated)49 MBSupported play modesTV modeTabletop modeHandheld modeNo. of playersSingle system (1)Nintendo Account family-group lendingSupportedNintendo Switch OnlineSave Data CloudPlay online, access classic NES™ and Super NES™ games, and more with a Nintendo Switch Online membership. IMMERSIVE EXPERIENCE SPANNING 6 DECADESEach decade features its own visual identity and carefully curated tracklist, letting you jump between musical eras or build the ultimate throwback-to-modern playlist in one seamless experience. Discover it all through the all-new Adventure Mode, a cheerful story-driven journey that has you dancing your way through the decades.DANCE TO SONGS EVERYONE KNOWSCelebrate iconic intergenerational hits brought to life with unique choreography, including fan favorites like:- "NUEVAYoL" by Bad Bunny- "Manchild" by Sabrina Carpenter- "Danza Kuduro" by Lucenzo Ft. Don Omar- "Turn Down for What" by DJ Snake & Lil Jon- "Feel Good Inc." by Gorillaz- "Bye Bye Bye" by *NSYNC- "Wannabe" by Spice Girls- "No Scrubs" by TLC- "It's Tricky" by Run-D.M.C- "Uptown Girl" by Billy Joel- "Mamma Mia" by ABBAAND MORE!From easy-to-follow to satisfyingly challenging, this year's tracklist is made to get players of all ages and styles dancing together!DISCOVER A FUN ADVENTURE FOR ALL GENERATIONSExplore the decades together in the new Adventure Mode. Discover 6 themed worlds, dance to iconic songs, enjoy fun mini-activities, and unlock exclusive rewards. Only available with Just Dance: Decades of Hits!ENDLESS WAYS TO PARTYDance with up to 6 players locally, jump into Party Mode, or get moving with Workout Mode.
